column1: 2xz1qo	Early stage startup. Should I focus on monetization or focus on growth?	"Hi everyone. The app started as a side project over the summer and ended up getting around 600 users in about 2 months with very little marketing.
Our price for the app is free and we plan to make money with either targeted advertising
column2: job ads
column3: and affiliate marketing. The thing is I don't want to focus on any of that anytime soon. I want to grow the app and release it at other schools. You know your typical grow first
column4: make money second. Especially in our circumstance where more users equals more money.

column1: The problem is some of the people I work with are your typical business types. Make money now
column2: use it to fuel growth. I'm not trying to stick ads on the app much earlier. I see it in our best interest to grow our user base and then create an advertising platform. The thing though is creating that advertising platform would require development time and since I'm the only developer
column3: I believe it's best to focus on the user experience.

column1: The people I work with are considering is starting to make money within the next couple of months and I'm thinking in 12-18 months.
Their thinking is that no one is going to invest in a $0 revenue company and that $1000/mo is better than $0/mo. My thinking is that $1000 initially is
1) Not going to happen with little initial users
2) No investor cares about $1000/mo. They want to see that the idea can grow. $1000/mo might as well just get a bank loan.
3) Sticking ads this early will kill the user experience.
So what are your guys thoughts on my situation? I appreciate any feedback."	keep
